overall_goal: Clean dishes, manage food scraps, log ingredient nutritional values, and stir the cooking onions

goals.description: Add onions to the wok and stir them
goals.rationale: The person transfers the onions into the wok and shakes it to start cooking.

goals.description: Prepare and add chilli pepper to the pot
goals.rationale: The person selects a chilli pepper, cuts it into pieces, and adds it to the pot.

goals.description: Log the nutritional value of the chilli pepper
goals.rationale: The person uses their phone to update the nutritional information for the chilli pepper.

goals.description: Put away leftover ingredients in the refrigerator
goals.rationale: The person organizes the fridge and stores tupperware and mushrooms.

goals.description: Prepare the sink and wash the knives
goals.rationale: The person moves items to the sink, prepares the soapy sponge, and washes and dries the knives.

goals.description: Wash the cutting board and colander
goals.rationale: The person scrubs, rinses, and places the cutting board and colander on the drying rack.

goals.description: Dispose of food scraps and wipe the kitchen counter
goals.rationale: The person gathers food scraps into a bowl, empties them into the trash, and wipes the counter clean.
The person washes, rinses, and sets the metal bowl to dry.

goals.description: Stir the onions in the wok
goals.rationale: The person mixes the cooking onions and adjusts the stove temperature.
The person brings small and large plates to the sink, washes them, and places them on the drying rack.
The person retrieves chopped tomatoes, tomato sauce, and minced beef from the counter.

goals.description: Stir the onions in the wok again
goals.rationale: The person continues to mix the onions, wipes the sides of the wok, and shakes it.

goals.description: Log the nutritional value of the minced beef
goals.rationale: The person scans the barcode on the minced beef packaging with their phone to record its nutritional data.

goals.description: Stir the onions in the wok once more
goals.rationale: The person mixes the onions again to ensure they cook evenly.

goals.description: Log the nutritional value of the chopped tomatoes
goals.rationale: The person uses their phone to scan the barcode on the can of chopped tomatoes.
